The '''Drinking Cup''' was a naturally bowl-shaped pit located on the planet [[Trogan/Legends|Trogan]]. Near the city of [[Kergara]], the Drinking Cup was noted for the seawater that flooded its bottom, which allowed for the formation of whirlpools during tidal shifts. Because of this, the [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Whistler (Ortolan)|Whistler]] decided to build a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] in the central shaft of the Cup. [[Whistler's Whirlpool Tapcafe|Whistler's Whirlpool]] had a brief period of popularity before eventually shutting its doors.
